title: A rights holder who weighs what a defendant can pay leaves non-monetized operators unlitigated even when their conduct matches a commercial rival's
body:
- Rights holders concentrate enforcement on commercial AI startups with significant valuations because litigation costs require damages large enough to justify the expense.
- Non-monetized operations running on personal infrastructure fall beneath the threshold of corporate litigation interest even when their conduct is comparable to a commercial rival's.
- For non-monetized operators, automated DMCA takedowns replace lawsuits as the practical risk when verbatim text is accidentally pulled.
conversion: A non-monetized operator's identical conduct produces different enforcement outcomes than a commercial rival's because the calculus targets collectable damages, not the underlying violation.
